title: Late Arrivals Early in an Appointment Series — Questions Answered
content:
Training questions on the new-series share in the late-arrival fee of an Appointment Series.

**The rule.** The late-arrival new-series share is 75 percent where the series start date is no more than 14 calendar days before the assessment date, 90 percent where it is more than 14 but no more than 28 days before, and 100 percent where it is more than 28 days before. The share is read as a percentage of the late-arrival basis and multiplies it.

**Which date is the starting point?** The series start date on the series record, counted in calendar days to the assessment date.

**The series started exactly 14 days before the assessment — which share?** 75 percent. At 15 days it is 90 percent.

**Exactly 28 days?** 90 percent. At 29 days it is 100 percent.

**Example (hypothetical figures).** A series that started 10 days before the assessment, on a late-arrival basis of USD 35.00: 75 percent of USD 35.00 is USD 26.25.
